sections.title: Practical Safety for an Orlando Trip
sections.summary: Plan for the practical parts of a visit: Florida heat, driving and parking, protecting belongings, and recognizing tourist scams. Conditions vary by location, so use current local information for your itinerary.
bullets: Orlando is spread out, and many visitors rely on a car, hotel transport, or rideshare. Check the actual route and service for your plans.
This guide covers Florida heat, highway driving, protecting belongings, timeshare and ticket scams, and where to find help.
For nighttime area comparisons and evening return planning, see our dedicated Orlando night-safety guide.
